name: Arcane Ballad
description: Fuels the destructive power of your group members, allowing them to strike with Arcane Ballad Effect, which deals 11943 damage when they cast a damaging spell up to level 110, or a chance to strike with Arcane Ballad Strike, which deals 10988 damage, when making melee attacks. Lasts for 12 seconds or until you have enhanced 4 spells.
